_about: Settings for scripts/check-a11y.js (the accessibility gate). Every entry says why it is here; see scripts/README.md.

stateClasses._reason: Classes the page's own scripts add and remove while somebody uses the page. The gate tries each one on every element a stylesheet rule could apply it to, so text that is only styled in that state (an active step, a lit word, an open menu) is measured too. A class named here that no stylesheet rule uses any more is reported as stale in strict mode.

exempt.reason: The COVERED logo is brand artwork. WCAG 1.4.3 exempts text that is part of a logo, and the logo colours are fixed on purpose (not editable in the CMS).

genericLinkText._reason: Link and button text that tells nobody where it goes. 'error' texts fail the check, 'warn' texts are listed. Compared in lower case, ignoring trailing punctuation and arrows.

excludePagesFrom: scripts/copy-allowlist.json (excludePages): the internal tools /og/ /ident/ /cms/ /admin/ are not public pages and are not checked
